zh: 耶和華是我們的保護者

p.src: 1  I will lift up my eyes to the hills. Where does my help come from?

en: I will lift up my eyes to the hills. Where does my help come from?
u.src: 1  I will lift up my eyes to the hills. Where does my help come from?

p.src: 2  My help comes from the LORD, who made heaven and earth.

en: My help comes from the LORD, who made heaven and earth.
u.src: 2  My help comes from the LORD, who made heaven and earth.

p.src: 3  He will not allow your foot to be moved. He who keeps you will not slumber.

en: He will not allow your foot to be moved. He who keeps you will not slumber.
u.src: 3  He will not allow your foot to be moved. He who keeps you will not slumber.

p.src: 4  Behold, he who keeps Israel will neither slumber nor sleep.

en: Behold, he who keeps Israel will neither slumber nor sleep.
u.src: 4  Behold, he who keeps Israel will neither slumber nor sleep.

p.src: 5  The LORD is your keeper. The LORD is your shade on your right hand.

en: The LORD is your keeper. The LORD is your shade on your right hand.
u.src: 5  The LORD is your keeper. The LORD is your shade on your right hand.

p.src: 6  The sun will not harm you by day, nor the moon by night.

en: The sun will not harm you by day, nor the moon by night.
u.src: 6  The sun will not harm you by day, nor the moon by night.

p.src: 7  The LORD will keep you from all evil. He will keep your soul.

en: The LORD will keep you from all evil. He will keep your soul.
u.src: 7  The LORD will keep you from all evil. He will keep your soul.

p.src: 8  The LORD will keep your going out and your coming in, from this time forward, and forever more.

en: The LORD will keep your going out and your coming in, from this time forward, and forever more.
u.src: 8  The LORD will keep your going out and your coming in, from this time forward, and forever more.
